decisions.reason: As a dedicated space navigation and observation camera with its own product page, it fits closely with a large German optical-electronics firm's existing knowledge base and gives enough strategic signal to justify learning and refinement rather than withdrawal.

The modular space navigation camera also builds strongly on related imaging capabilities, and its modularity increases the firm's ability to absorb customer feedback and improve the product through incremental development.

Although a sensor suite is somewhat more system-complex, it still draws on adjacent sensing and electronics competences, so a large incumbent with R&D capacity would typically keep it on the market to deepen learning and integration.

The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor is technologically related but appears less established because it was only mentioned rather than fully presented, so it faces a higher risk of withdrawal, yet the firm's absorptive capacity still supports keeping it for another year.
